datasets.name: boxes_anual
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    NISE,
    PLAN,
    CASE
      WHEN METRICA = 'DEMANDA' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(OPERACION, 'kVARh', 'kVAR'), 'kWh', 'kW')
      ELSE OPERACION
    END AS OPERACION,
    ANIO,
    CAST(HORA AS INT) AS HORA,
    METRICA,
    WHISKER_MIN,
    Q1,
    Q2,
    Q3,
    WHISKER_MAX,
    MEDIA,
    N,
    OUTLIERS_COUNT
  FROM
    desarrollo_cnfl_central_us.oro.boxes_anual
)
SELECT
  NISE,
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  ANIO,
  HORA,
  METRICA,
  'WHISKER_MAX' as ESTADISTICA,
  WHISKER_MAX as VALOR,
  N,
  OUTLIERS_COUNT
FROM
  src
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NISE,
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  ANIO,
  HORA,
  METRICA,
  'Q3',
  Q3,
  N,
  OUTLIERS_COUNT
FROM
  src
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NISE,
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  ANIO,
  HORA,
  METRICA,
  'MEDIA',
  MEDIA,
  N,

FROM
  src
UNION ALL

  src

datasets.name: boxes_tmt_vs_tmtb_long
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    NISE,
    PLAN,
    CASE
      WHEN METRICA = 'DEMANDA' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(OPERACION, 'kVARh', 'kVAR'), 'kWh', 'kW')
      ELSE OPERACION
    END AS OPERACION,
    ANIO,
    HORA,
    METRICA,
    Q2 AS MEDIANA,
    MEDIA,
    IQR
  FROM
    desarrollo_cnfl_central_us.oro.boxes_anual
  WHERE
    PLAN IN ('TMT', 'TMTB')
)
SELECT
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  ANIO,
  HORA,
  METRICA,
  ROUND(AVG(MEDIANA), 3) AS MEDIANA_PROM,
  ROUND(AVG(MEDIA), 3) AS MEDIA_PROM,
  ROUND(AVG(IQR), 3) AS VARIABILIDAD_IQR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NISE) AS NISES
FROM
  src
GROUP BY
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  ANIO,
  HORA,
  METRICA

datasets.name: plata_950_perfil
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.NISE,
    CASE
      WHEN t.nis IS NOT NULL THEN 'TMT'
      WHEN tb.nis IS NOT NULL THEN 'TMTB'
      ELSE 'OTRO'
    END AS PLAN,
    CASE
      WHEN METRICA = 'DEMANDA' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(p.OPERACION, 'kVARh', 'kVAR'), 'kWh', 'kW')
      ELSE p.OPERACION
    END AS OPERACION,
    p.FECHA,
    HOUR(p.FECHA_LECTURA) AS HORA,
    CASE
      WHEN dayofweek(p.FECHA) IN (1, 7) THEN 'FIN_DE_SEMANA'
      ELSE 'ENTRE_SEMANA'
    END AS TIPO_DIA,
    METRICA,
    VALOR
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        NISE,
        OPERACION,
        FECHA_LECTURA,
        FECHA,
        STACK(2, 'ENERGIA', ENERGIA, 'DEMANDA', DEMANDA) AS (METRICA, VALOR)
      FROM
        desarrollo_cnfl_central_us.plata_analisis.plata_950_carga
    ) p
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(nis AS STRING) AS nis
        FROM
          desarrollo_cnfl_central_us.bronce.tmt
      ) t
        ON p.NISE = t.nis
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(nis AS STRING) AS nis
        FROM
          desarrollo_cnfl_central_us.bronce.tmtb
      ) tb
        ON p.NISE = tb.nis
  WHERE
    VALOR IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  NISE,
  PLAN,
  OPERACION,
  FECHA,
  HORA,
  TIPO_DIA,
  METRICA,
  ROUND(VALOR, 4) AS VALOR
FROM
  base
